description: Run tailored mock interviews from a resume or LinkedIn profile and a job description, with adaptive follow-ups and evidence-based coaching.

defaultPrompt: Start a voice-first mock interview tailored to my background and a specific job opening.
Help me practice a tough hiring-manager interview for a job I'm applying to.
Run a behavioral mock interview and give me candid feedback at the end.
interface.longDescription: Prepare in text, rehearse in voice where supported, and leave with a practical improvement plan. Provide a resume or LinkedIn profile and a job description using native attachments, links, or pasted text. Interview Rehearsal verifies available sources, analyzes role fit, offers a recommended setup, and conducts one-question-at-a-time interviews calibrated to role, seniority, and stage. Includes adaptive follow-ups, evidence-based feedback, targeted retries, and transfer questions to test improvement. Works across professions and experience levels. Users enable host voice mode themselves; text remains fully supported. Uses available host browsing and file tools with readable-text fallbacks; no separate server or guaranteed hiring predictions. After the debrief, request a PDF interview prep brief with story cues, targeted drills, and questions to ask. The desktop-only plugin bundles a local Python PDF generator with branded formatting. PDF export requires local execution, Python, and ReportLab; a readable-text brief is available as a fallback.

prompts: Help me prepare for a realistic mock interview. Ask for the job description and my background first.
Run a behavioral interview with feedback at the end. Let me retry an answer without hints.
Help me practice a weak interview answer, then test the same skill with a different question.
After my mock interview debrief, create a PDF prep brief I can save and study, using only my verified background and answers.

publication.release_notes: Adds a bundled local PDF prep-brief generator with the Interview Rehearsal icon, selectable text, source links, and page numbers. Declares desktop execution and retains evidence-based coaching and readable-text fallbacks. No MCP server or remote PDF service is used.

name: interview-rehearsal
